KEPLERIAN.description: Keplerian classical set in STATE_DATA, 6 values per row: semi-major axis [km], eccentricity, inclination, right ascension of the ascending node, argument of periapsis and true anomaly [deg]. SANA Orbital Elements KEPLERIAN (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.11).

KEPLERIAN_MEAN.description: As KEPLERIAN with the mean anomaly in place of the true anomaly. SANA Orbital Elements KEPLERIANMEAN (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.12).

EQUINOCTIAL.description: Equinoctial set in STATE_DATA, 7 values per row: semi-major axis [km], af = e cos(argp + fr RAAN), ag = e sin(argp + fr RAAN), mean longitude L = M + argp + fr RAAN [deg], chi = tan(i/2)^fr sin(RAAN), psi = tan(i/2)^fr cos(RAAN), and the retrograde factor fr (+1 or -1). SANA Orbital Elements EQUINOCTIAL (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.8).

EQUINOCTIAL_MOD.description: Modified equinoctial set, 7 values per row: semi-latus rectum p = a (1 - e^2) [km], af, ag, true longitude L' = nu + argp + fr RAAN [deg], chi, psi, fr. SANA Orbital Elements EQUINOCTIALMOD (OID 1.3.112.4.57.5.9).

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY.description: The centre of mass of a single celestial body.

BARYCENTRE.description: The barycentre of a named system of bodies.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: A libration (Lagrange) point of a two-body system.

SPACE_OBJECT.description: Another tracked space object, identified by OBJECT_ID.

GROUND_SITE.description: A fixed site on a body surface, identified by SITE_ID and the geodetic fields on RFMOrigin.

CELESTIAL_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code when KIND is CELESTIAL_BODY.

BARYCENTRE_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the barycentre when KIND is BARYCENTRE.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: Which libration point, when KIND is LIBRATION_POINT.

LIBRATION_PRIMARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system primary.

LIBRATION_SECONDARY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the libration system secondary.

OBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the space object when KIND is SPACE_OBJECT.

SITE_ID.description: Identifier of the surface site when KIND is GROUND_SITE.

SITE_BODY_ID.description: Ephemeris body code of the body the site sits on.

SITE_LATITUDE.description: Geodetic latitude of the site, degrees, positive north.

SITE_LONGITUDE.description: Geodetic longitude of the site, degrees, positive east.

SITE_ALTITUDE.description: Height of the site above the reference ellipsoid, metres.

RFMObjectReferencedAxes.description:
Axes built from the relative geometry of two objects. Exactly two of the
three axis assignments are independent; the third completes the triad.

ORBIT_NORMAL.description: Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.

RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.description:
Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the
coordinate system named by REFERENCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

NAME.description: Stable name for this coordinate system within the producing data set.

MEAN_EQUATOR_EQUINOX_J2000.description: Mean equator and mean equinox of the J2000.0 epoch.

MEAN_ECLIPTIC_EQUINOX_J2000.description: Mean ecliptic and mean equinox of the J2000.0 epoch.

TRUE_EQUATOR_MEAN_EQUINOX_OF_DATE.description: True equator, mean equinox of date.

MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR.description: Mean equator of date (precession applied to the epoch of the state).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR.description: True equator of date (precession and nutation applied).

MEAN_OF_EPOCH_EQUATOR.description: Mean equator of a fixed reference epoch.

MEAN_OF_EPOCH_ECLIPTIC.description: Mean ecliptic of a fixed reference epoch.

TRUE_OF_EPOCH_EQUATOR.description: True equator of a fixed reference epoch.

TRUE_OF_EPOCH_ECLIPTIC.description: True ecliptic of a fixed reference epoch.

BODY_FIXED.description: Axes rotating with the body named by AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_NAIF_ID, per its published rotation elements.

BODY_INERTIAL.description: Non-rotating axes aligned with the reference body's equator and prime meridian at the reference epoch.

OBJECT_REFERENCED.description: Axes built from the relative geometry of two named objects; see RFMObjectReferencedAxes.

LOCAL_ALIGNED_CONSTRAINED.description: Axes built by aligning one vector and constraining a second; see RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.

BODY_EQUATOR.description: Axes in the reference body's equatorial plane at the requested epoch.

SOLAR_ECLIPTIC_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-ecliptic magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z along the ecliptic north, commonly abbreviated GSE.

SOLAR_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z in the plane containing the body magnetic dipole, commonly abbreviated GSM.

TOPOCENTRIC.description: Local horizon axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin.

BODY_SPIN_SUN.description: Axes fixed by the body spin axis and the body-to-Sun direction.

EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED.description: Axes defined by a loaded ephemeris/orientation kernel; identified by KERNEL_FRAME_NAME / KERNEL_FRAME_ID on RFMCoordinateSystem.

MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED rather than left implicit: mean equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession theory instead of the IAU-2006/2000A chain. Results differ from MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR at the milliarcsecond level and the two are not interchangeable.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED: true equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession-nutation theory. See MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS1996.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (1996) reduction (IERS Technical Note 21): IAU 1976 precession, IAU 1980 nutation with the observed celestial pole offsets applied. Distinct from TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5 (no offsets) and TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR (IAU-2006/2000A).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS2003.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (2003) reduction (IERS Technical Note 32): IAU 2000A nutation on the IAU 1976 precession with the IAU 2000 precession-rate corrections. The mean-of-date equator under this reduction is MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TOPOCENTRIC_EAST_NORTH_UP.description: Topocentric East-North-Up axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin. TOPOCENTRIC (20) does not fix the axis order; this does.

TOPOCENTRIC_NORTH_EAST_DOWN.description: Topocentric North-East-Down axes at a surface site.

TOPOCENTRIC_SOUTH_EAST_ZENITH.description: Topocentric South-East-Zenith axes at a surface site.

ORBITAL_VELOCITY_NORMAL_CONORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X along the velocity, Z along the orbit normal, Y completing the right-handed set (VNC). The object is the origin body of the coordinate system.

ORBITAL_RADIAL_TRANSVERSE_NORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X radial (outward), Z along the orbit normal, Y transverse completing the set (RTN, also RSW).

ORBITAL_LOCAL_VERTICAL_LOCAL_HORIZONTAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: Z toward the central body (nadir), Y opposite the orbit normal, X completing the set (LVLH).

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

GCRF.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.9 Inertial Earth-centered frame aligned with Earth's center of mass.

ICRF.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.11 International Celestial Reference Frame based on distant quasars.

J2000.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.14 Classical J2000 inertial frame defined at epoch J2000.0.

J2000A.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.15 Updated J2000 frame using IAU2000A precession-nutation models.

EME2000.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.7 Earth Mean Equator frame at epoch J2000 used in orbit determination.

TEMEOFDATE.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.25 True Equator Mean Equinox of Date frame for satellite tracking.

GTOD.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.10 Greenwich True of Date: Earth rotation relative to celestial reference.

CIRS.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.4 Celestial Intermediate Reference System based on CIP and CIO.

MOD_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.18 Mean of Date (MOD) Earth frame using IAU1976 precession.

MOD_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.17 Mean of Date (MOD) celestial body frame evaluated at each epoch.

MOD_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.19 Mean of Date (MOD) Moon frame evaluated at each epoch.

TOD_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.29 True of Date (TOD) Earth frame with polar motion included.

TOD_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.28 True of Date (TOD) celestial body frame.

TOD_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.30 True of Date (TOD) Moon frame.

TOE_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.32 True of Epoch (TOE) Earth frame at specific epoch.

TOE_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.31 True of Epoch (TOE) celestial body frame at specific epoch.

TOE_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.33 True of Epoch (TOE) Moon frame at specific epoch.

EFG.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.6 Earth-Fixed Geocentric frame using geodetic coordinates.

FIXED_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.8 Fixed frame of a celestial body.

FIXED_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.39 Fixed Earth frame aligned with WGS84 ellipsoid.

DTRFYYYY.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.5 Dynamic Terrestrial Reference Frame for a given year (DTRFYYYY).

ALIGN_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.2 Mean Earth Equator and Equinox (ALIGN_EARTH) frame.

ALIGN_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.1 Mean Central Body Equator and Equinox (ALIGN_CB) frame.

B1950.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.3 Classical Besselian 1950 equator and equinox frame.

EQW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.1 Earth Equatorial Inertial frame aligned with J2000 epoch.

LVLH_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.3 Local Vertical Local Horizontal inertial frame.

LVLH_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.2 Local Vertical Local Horizontal rotating frame.

NSW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.5 Normal along-track cross-track inertial frame.

NSW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.4 Normal along-track cross-track rotating frame.

NTW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.7 Orbit normal Tangential cross-track inertial frame.

NTW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.6 Orbit normal Tangential cross-track rotating frame.

PQW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.8 Perifocal frame aligned with orbit's perigee.

RSW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.10 Radial along-track cross-track inertial frame.

RSW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.9 Radial along-track cross-track rotating frame.

TNW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.12 Transverse normal cross-track inertial frame.

TNW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.11 Transverse normal cross-track rotating frame.

ECEF.description: Earth-Centered-Earth-Fixed: Rotates with Earth. X-axis at prime meridian, Y eastward, Z towards North Pole.

TEME.description: True Equator Mean Equinox of Date, same as TEMEOFDATE: Dynamic frame for SGP4 satellite tracking.

TEMEOFEPOCH.description: True Equator Mean Equinox of Epoch: Static version of TEMEOFDATE at a given epoch.

ENU.description: East-North-Up: Local tangent plane for surface points.

NED.description: North-East-Down: Aviation/navigation frame aligned with gravity.

NEU.description: North-East-Up: Local tangent plane variant with Up positive.

RIC.description: Radial-Intrack-Cross-track: Spacecraft orientation aligned with orbit.

RTN.description: Radial-Transverse-Normal: Orbit frame for spacecraft dynamics.

VVLH.description: Vehicle-Velocity-Local-Horizontal: Orbit frame aligned with velocity vector.

LTP.description: Local Tangent Plane: Surface-fixed frame centered on a point.

LVLH.description: Local Vertical-Local Horizontal: Z axis towards Earth center, X along velocity.

BRF.description: Body-Fixed Reference Frame: Fixed to a spacecraft or celestial object.

FRMStateVector.description:
A state in a named element set at a named epoch. ELEMENTS is the element
set's own 6 values in the order documented on frmStateRepresentation.
POSITION and VELOCITY are the Cartesian projection of the same state and
are populated when REPRESENTATION is CARTESIAN or when the provider can
supply them; a consumer MUST NOT infer velocity from POSITION alone.

KEPLERIAN.description: SMA, ECC, INC, RAAN, AOP, TA.

MODIFIED_KEPLERIAN.description: RadPer, RadApo, INC, RAAN, AOP, TA.

SPHERICAL_AZFPA.description: RMAG, RA, DEC, VMAG, azimuth, flight-path angle.

SPHERICAL_RADEC.description: RMAG, RA, DEC, VMAG, right ascension of velocity, declination of velocity.

EQUINOCTIAL.description: SMA, h, k, p, q, mean longitude.

MODIFIED_EQUINOCTIAL.description: p, f, g, h, k, true longitude.

ALTERNATE_EQUINOCTIAL.description: Equinoctial variant using mean motion in place of the semi-major axis.

DELAUNAY.description: Delaunay canonical variables l, g, h, L, G, H.

PLANETODETIC.description: Geodetic latitude/longitude/height with the horizon velocity triple.

BROUWER_MEAN_SHORT.description: Brouwer-Lyddane mean elements, short-period terms only.

BROUWER_MEAN_LONG.description: Brouwer-Lyddane mean elements, short and long period terms.

ELEMENTS.description: The 6 element values of REPRESENTATION, SI units and radians.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the coordinate system these elements are expressed in; resolves
against RFMCoordinateSystem.NAME.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description:
Gravitational parameter, m^3/s^2, of the origin body when the element
set requires one. Absent means the provider's default for the origin.

STATE_TRANSFORM.description: Transform a full state (position AND velocity) from SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM to TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM at EPOCH, expressed in TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

FRAME_ROTATION.description: Return only the rotation from SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM to TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM at EPOCH, with its time derivative and the angular velocity of the target axes. No state is required.

STATE_REPRESENTATION_CONVERT.description: Convert a state between element sets within ONE coordinate system.

SOURCE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the request's state is expressed in.

TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system the result is required in.

SOURCE_STATE.description:
The full input state, carrying velocity as well as position. POSITION
above is position-only and remains the input for operations 1-4.

TARGET_REPRESENTATION.description: Element set the result must be expressed in.

KEPLERIAN.description: SMA, ECC, INC, RAAN, AOP, TA.

MODIFIED_KEPLERIAN.description: RadPer, RadApo, INC, RAAN, AOP, TA.

SPHERICAL_AZFPA.description: RMAG, RA, DEC, VMAG, azimuth, flight-path angle.

SPHERICAL_RADEC.description: RMAG, RA, DEC, VMAG, right ascension of velocity, declination of velocity.

EQUINOCTIAL.description: SMA, h, k, p, q, mean longitude.

MODIFIED_EQUINOCTIAL.description: p, f, g, h, k, true longitude.

ALTERNATE_EQUINOCTIAL.description: Equinoctial variant using mean motion in place of the semi-major axis.

DELAUNAY.description: Delaunay canonical variables l, g, h, L, G, H.

PLANETODETIC.description: Geodetic latitude/longitude/height with the horizon velocity triple.

BROUWER_MEAN_SHORT.description: Brouwer-Lyddane mean elements, short-period terms only.

BROUWER_MEAN_LONG.description: Brouwer-Lyddane mean elements, short and long period terms.

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the transform is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for every
time-dependent axis chain.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH, named by the $TIM timingStandard member name.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set the caller requires
the provider to use. A provider that cannot honour it returns
MISSING_EOP_DATA rather than substituting another table.

UNSUPPORTED_AXIS_TYPE.description: The provider does not implement the requested axis set.

UNSUPPORTED_STATE_REPRESENTATION.description: The provider does not implement the requested element set.

MISSING_EOP_DATA.description: The axis chain needs Earth-orientation data that was not supplied or does not span EPOCH. The provider MUST fail here rather than silently extrapolate.

SINGULAR_ELEMENT_SET.description: The state is at a singularity of the requested element set (for example e -> 0 for Keplerian). The provider MUST report this rather than substitute a different element set.

TARGET_STATE.description:
The transformed state, with velocity, in TARGET_COORDINATE_SYSTEM and
TARGET_REPRESENTATION.

ROTATION_DCM.description: Rotation from the source axes to the target axes at EPOCH.

ROTATION_DCM_RATE.description:
Time derivative of ROTATION_DCM, per second. Required for a velocity
transform between relatively rotating axis sets.

ANGULAR_VELOCITY_RAD_S.description:
Angular velocity of the target axes with respect to the source axes,
radians per second, expressed in the source axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_EPOCH.description: Epoch of the Earth-orientation data set actually used, ISO 8601.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description: Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set actually used.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

A1.description: Atomic time scale of the reference atomic-time network, offset from International Atomic Time by the fixed constant A1 - TAI = 0.0343817 s exactly. Appended last; never reorder or reuse existing values.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.description: GNSS week number plus seconds within the week.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS binary time-code field with preamble metadata.

MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: Seconds from an application-defined mission epoch.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS binary time-code field with preamble metadata.

MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: Seconds from an application-defined mission epoch.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Input epoch or requested representation is invalid.

UNSUPPORTED_TIME_SYSTEM.description: Requested source or target time system is not supported.

LEAP_SECOND_DATA_REQUIRED.description: Conversion requires leap-second data that was not available.

EOP_DATA_REQUIRED.description: Conversion requires Earth-orientation data that was not available.

OUT_OF_RANGE.description: Requested instant is outside the supported conversion range.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

A1.description: Atomic time scale of the reference atomic-time network, offset from International Atomic Time by the fixed constant A1 - TAI = 0.0343817 s exactly. Appended last; never reorder or reuse existing values.

PCEParameterRef.description:
A reference to one parameter, with the dependencies that make it evaluable.
This is what a request, a stopping condition and a report column all name.

POSITION_X.description: --- 1..29 Cartesian state and its direct magnitudes --------------------

RIGHT_ASCENSION.description: Right ascension of the position vector.

VELOCITY_RIGHT_ASCENSION.description: Right ascension of the velocity vector.

FLIGHT_PATH_ANGLE.description: Angle between the velocity vector and the local horizontal plane.

AZIMUTH_ANGLE.description: Azimuth of the velocity vector, measured from local north.

HORIZONTAL_FLIGHT_PATH_ANGLE.description: Flight path angle measured from the local horizontal.

RADIAL_VELOCITY.description: Component of velocity along the position unit vector. Its zero crossing IS the apsis condition; a stop at apoapsis is this parameter with goal 0 and direction DECREASING.

SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS.description: --- 30..69 Keplerian elements and derived orbit scalars ----------------

CHARACTERISTIC_ENERGY.description: Twice the specific orbital energy; the square of the hyperbolic excess speed on an escape trajectory.

ARGUMENT_OF_LATITUDE.description: Argument of periapsis plus true anomaly.

BETA_ANGLE.description: Angle between the orbit plane and the direction to the illuminating body.

LOCAL_SIDEREAL_TIME.description: Local sidereal time at the sub-object meridian.

PRIME_MERIDIAN_HOUR_ANGLE.description: Hour angle of the body prime meridian.

RIGHT_ASCENSION_OF_DEPARTURE_ASYMPTOTE.description: Right ascension of the departure asymptote.

ORBIT_STATE_TRANSITION_MATRIX.description: --- 160..179 state transition and covariance matrices ------------------ Six by six orbit state transition matrix, row-major.

ORBIT_ERROR_COVARIANCE_MATRIX.description: Six by six orbit error covariance, row-major, in the request's coordinate system.

EPOCH_A1_GREGORIAN.description: --- 180..219 time ------------------------------------------------------ Each EPOCH_ member is the owner epoch expressed in one time system. GREGORIAN members are ISO 8601 text; MODIFIED_JULIAN members are a day count. The time system is named by the $TIM timingStandard member.

MOMENT_OF_INERTIA_MATRIX.description: Three by three inertia tensor, row-major, in body axes.

ATTITUDE_QUATERNION_4.description: Scalar component of the attitude quaternion.

ATTITUDE_DIRECTION_COSINE_MATRIX.description: Three by three direction cosine matrix, row-major.

THRUSTER_THRUST_COEFFICIENTS.description: Coefficient vector of the thrust polynomial; address one coefficient with PCEParameterRef.ELEMENT_INDEX.

THRUSTER_IMPULSE_COEFFICIENTS.description: Coefficient vector of the specific-impulse polynomial; address one coefficient with PCEParameterRef.ELEMENT_INDEX.

IMPULSIVE_BURN_ELEMENT_1.description: --- 370..389 impulsive velocity change --------------------------------- First component of the velocity change in the burn coordinate system.

SOLVER_STATUS.description: --- 450..469 solver ---------------------------------------------------- Run state of the solver, as an integer code the solver family defines.

RELATIVE_RANGE.description: --- 470..499 relative geometry and observation ------------------------- Distance from the owner to PCEParameterRef.SECOND_OBJECT_ID.

TOPOCENTRIC_AZIMUTH.description: Azimuth of the owner as seen from the site named on the request.

TOPOCENTRIC_ELEVATION.description: Elevation of the owner as seen from the site named on the request.

ANGULAR_SEPARATION.description: Angle subtended at the owner between two named directions.

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE.description: Angle at the owner between the illuminating body and the observer.

LOCAL_SOLAR_ELEVATION_ANGLE.description: Elevation of the illuminating body at the site named on the request.

PCEParameterCondition.description:
A predicate on a named parameter: the parameter attains GOAL_VALUE, in
DIRECTION, for the OCCURRENCE-th time. This is the ONE spelling of a
stopping condition and of a generic event function; $EVL references it
rather than minting a second one.

GOAL_VALUE.description: Value the parameter must attain, in the parameter's own SI unit.

ANY_CROSSING.description: Any crossing of GOAL_VALUE, in either direction.

INCREASING.description: Only a crossing with the parameter increasing through GOAL_VALUE.

DECREASING.description: Only a crossing with the parameter decreasing through GOAL_VALUE.

GOAL_TOLERANCE.description:
Convergence bar on the parameter value at the reported epoch, in the
parameter's own unit. A provider that cannot meet it returns
ROOT_REFINEMENT_FAILED rather than reporting an unconverged root.

OCCURRENCE.description:
Which attainment satisfies the condition, one-based. 0 and 1 both mean
the first.

PCEStopRequest.description:
Propagate until a condition is attained. The propagator itself is NOT named
here: it is a port the caller supplies, per the pluggable-propagation law.

CONDITIONS.description:
Conditions evaluated together; the run stops at whichever is attained

MAXIMUM_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description:
Upper bound on the propagated interval. Reaching it without attaining a

EPOCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS.description:
Convergence bar on the stop epoch. The same scenario run at different
step sizes MUST land inside this bar.

SYNCHRONIZED_OBJECT_IDS.description:

REPORT_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters to evaluate at the stop epoch, beyond the condition itself.

PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CATALOG_URI.description:
Absolute URI identifying the original catalog's object-ID namespace.
This is an identifier, not an instruction to fetch a resource. Use with
CATALOG_OBJECT_ID only when both fields are present. Preserve the pair
through replicas and derived catalogs; it does not assert a NORAD or
COSPAR association. If the authority can reassign an object ID, this URI
must identify its immutable edition or assignment interval, rather than
the unversioned catalog. Stable IDs may use a persistent catalog URI.

CATALOG_OBJECT_ID.description:
Exact, opaque object identifier assigned by CATALOG_URI's authority.
Preserve case, Unicode and leading zeros. Numeric-looking native IDs
are not NORAD_CAT_ID values. Neither a matching name nor a native ID
in a different namespace establishes that two records describe the same
physical object. Publication provenance retains source and edition data.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

SMA.description: Semi-major axis (km). Standard for elliptical orbits.

R_PERIAPSIS.description: Radius of periapsis (km). Preferred for hyperbolic orbits.

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: Mean anomaly (linear in time for Keplerian motion).

ECCENTRIC_ANOMALY.description: Eccentric anomaly (auxiliary angle in the Kepler equation).

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

A1.description: Atomic time scale of the reference atomic-time network, offset from International Atomic Time by the fixed constant A1 - TAI = 0.0343817 s exactly. Appended last; never reorder or reuse existing values.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

NCDSegmentDescriptor.description:
One independently addressed segment inside a native container.

A segmented binary ephemeris is not a single span: each segment has its own
body pair, frame, numeric type and time bounds, and a reader must choose
among them. $OEM carries the STATES; this carries the segment DESCRIPTOR
that says which states came from where and what must be written back.

NAME.description: Segment name as recorded in the container.

TARGET_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment target.

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment centre.

FRAME_NAIF_ID.description: Integer reference frame code of the segment.

FRAME_NAME.description: Reference frame name as recorded in the container.

SEGMENT_TYPE.description:
Numeric segment data type, verbatim. The evaluation rule is a property of
this number (for example, Chebyshev position with fixed interval, or
discrete states with Lagrange interpolation); it is carried as the
container's own integer so a rewrite is exact.

START_SECONDS_PAST_J2000_TDB.description:
Segment coverage start, seconds past J2000 in the barycentric dynamical
time scale, as stored in the container.

INITIAL_ADDRESS.description: First addressed element of the segment inside the file.

FINAL_ADDRESS.description: Last addressed element of the segment inside the file.

POLYNOMIAL_DEGREE.description:
Polynomial degree or record size the segment type parameterises, when the
type carries one.

NCDSP3Header.description: Header block of a fixed-column satellite position container (SP3).

FILE_TYPE.description:
Record content indicator, e.g. "P" for positions only, "V" with
velocities.

SATELLITE_SYSTEM.description: Satellite system indicator recorded in the header.

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type as recorded, e.g. fitted, extrapolated, broadcast, helmert.

DATA_USED.description: Data used to produce the file, as recorded.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Terrestrial reference frame name as recorded.

AGENCY.description:
Producing agency as recorded IN THE FILE. This is observed content, not a
classification.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system as recorded in the header.

GPS_WEEK.description: Week number of the first epoch in the file's own week counter.

SECONDS_OF_WEEK.description: Seconds of week of the first epoch.

MODIFIED_JULIAN_DAY_START.description: Modified Julian Day of the first epoch.

FRACTIONAL_DAY.description: Fractional day of the first epoch.

NUMBER_OF_EPOCHS.description: Number of epochs declared in the header.

SATELLITE_ACCURACY_EXPONENTS.description:
Per-satellite accuracy exponents, parallel to SATELLITE_IDS. The accuracy
is POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE raised to this power.

POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE.description:
Base for the position and velocity standard-deviation exponents carried
per state in $OEM.

CLOCK_RATE_BASE.description: Base for the clock bias and clock rate standard-deviation exponents.

COMMENT.description: Header comment lines in file order.

NCDScenarioEpochContainer.description: Parameters of a scenario-epoch text container.

SCENARIO_EPOCH.description: Epoch that every record offset is measured from, ISO 8601.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time scale the scenario epoch is expressed in.

DISTANCE_UNIT.description: Distance unit of the records, e.g. "Meters", "Kilometers".

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Named coordinate system of the records.

COORDINATE_AXES.description: Named coordinate axes, when stated separately from the system.

INTERPOLATION_SAMPLES_M1.description:
Interpolation order expressed as (samples - 1), which is how these
containers state it. Carried verbatim rather than converted, so a rewrite
reproduces the source exactly.

NUMBER_OF_EPHEMERIS_POINTS.description: Number of ephemeris points declared in the container.

SEGMENT_BOUNDARY_TIMES.description: Segment boundary offsets in seconds from SCENARIO_EPOCH, when present.

NCDCode500Header.description: Header words of a fixed-record binary ephemeris container.

SATELLITE_NAME.description: Object name as recorded in the header.

EPOCH_STEP_SECONDS.description: Uniform step between data records, seconds.

HEADER_WORDS.description:
The header record's packed words in file order, undecoded. A reader that
understands a word decodes it; a rewriter reproduces the record exactly
without having to.

NCD.description:
Native Container Descriptor.

The file-level facts of an ephemeris, attitude or tracking container that
are NOT properties of the messages inside it. $OEM, $AEM and $TDM carry the
states, attitudes and observations; none of them can carry the internal
file name, the comment area, the segment address ranges, the header accuracy
block or the interpolation order the source declared, because those describe
the CONTAINER. Without them a read-then-write cycle silently invents header
values, and a segmented binary file cannot be reproduced at all.

ONE record covers every container class rather than one record per format:
the file-level facts are the same kind of fact in each, and the
format-specific blocks are optional sub-tables selected by FORMAT. Only the
block matching FORMAT is populated.

SPK_DAF.description: Double-precision Array File container carrying Spacecraft and Planet Kernel segments: a binary file of typed, independently addressed ephemeris segments, each with an integer target and centre, an integer reference frame, a numeric segment type, and a contiguous address range inside the file.

SP3_C.description: SP3 version c: fixed-column text container of per-epoch satellite positions and optional velocities with a clock column, a header block of accuracy codes, and one uniform epoch interval.

SP3_D.description: SP3 version d: as SP3_C, with an unbounded satellite count and extended header lines.

CODE_500.description: Code-500 fixed-record binary ephemeris: a header record of packed words followed by fixed-length data records on a uniform step.

SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT.description: Scenario-epoch ephemeris text container: time-ordered position and velocity records whose epochs are offsets in seconds from a declared scenario epoch, qualified by a named coordinate system, a distance unit, a named interpolation method and an interpolation order.

SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.description: Scenario-epoch attitude text container: the attitude counterpart of SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT, carrying quaternion, Euler or angular velocity records against the same scenario epoch.

CCSDS_OEM_KVN.description: CCSDS Orbit Ephemeris Message, keyword-value notation.

CCSDS_AEM_KVN.description: CCSDS Attitude Ephemeris Message, keyword-value notation.

CCSDS_TDM_KVN.description: CCSDS Tracking Data Message, keyword-value notation.

PROVIDER_DEFINED.description: A container outside this roster. PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME states which; a producer never reuses a neighbouring member instead.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME.description: Format name when FORMAT is PROVIDER_DEFINED. Empty otherwise.

FORMAT_VERSION.description: Version of the container format as declared by the file itself.

PRODUCER.description: Producing system or organization as recorded IN THE FILE.

CREATION_DATE.description: Creation date recorded in the file, ISO 8601.

INTERNAL_FILE_NAME.description:
Container-internal file name, which is stored inside the file and is
independent of the name on disk.

COMMENT_AREA.description:
Free-text comment area carried inside the container, one entry per line,
in file order.

NATIVE_FRAME_NAME.description:
Reference frame name as the container itself spells it, before any
mapping onto $RFM.

NATIVE_FRAME_ID.description: Integer reference frame code as the container stores it.

NATIVE_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system as the container itself spells it, before any mapping onto
the ratified time-scale vocabulary.

SEGMENTS.description:
Descriptors of the container's segments, in file order. Empty for a
single-span container.

SP3_HEADER.description: Header block when FORMAT is SP3_C or SP3_D.

SCENARIO_CONTAINER.description:
Parameters when FORMAT is SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT or
SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.

CODE_500_HEADER.description: Header words when FORMAT is CODE_500.

START_TIME.description: Total coverage start across all segments, ISO 8601.

STOP_TIME.description: Total coverage stop across all segments, ISO 8601.

SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH.description: Length of the described container in bytes.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the described container's exact bytes, lowercase hex. This is
what makes the descriptor checkable: a consumer can prove the descriptor
belongs to the file it holds.

SOURCE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the described container when it is addressed by
content rather than by path.

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

OMM.description: Source is an OMM (CCSDS mean elements) FlatBuffer.

TLE.description: Source is a raw TLE line pair (3LE supported via NAME).

PPE.description: Source is a PPE (polynomial ephemeris) FlatBuffer.

KEPLERIAN.description: Source is a single classical Keplerian element set.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

Type of Cryptographic Signature Used

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DOMAIN.description: Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "node.example.org")

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over canonical EPM content (hex), produced by the entity's
signing key under the algorithm declared in SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
(absent declaration = Ed25519)

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

CQRObjectSource.description:
Exactly one scientific source arm, or a validated instance/source handle.
OMM/TLE use their native mean-element units; OEM/PPE km and km/s; OCM its
declared units. No implicit conversion of TEME, ECEF or ICRF-labelled data.

PROPAGATOR_PORT_ID.description: Host-connected provider for mean elements; no embedded fixed SGP4 choice.

SOURCE_EPOCH.description:
Optional source epoch and perigee/apogee altitude above the reference
Earth radius used by the source model, in SI metres (not geocentric radii).

HAS_APOGEE_ALTITUDE_M.description: True when APOGEE_ALTITUDE_M carries a value; false means absent.

CQRScreeningControls.description: Explicit UTC search window and positive resolution, SI seconds/metres.

PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Optional progress cadence; PIV carries backpressure, not scientific data.

HAS_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: True when PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

CQRPairRequest.description:
CONTROLS.COMBINED_RADIUS_M must equal PRIMARY_RADIUS_M + SECONDARY_RADIUS_M.
Reject inconsistent radii instead of silently choosing one source.

EVALUATION_FRAME.description: Common inertial frame used for relative state and encounter-plane geometry.

CQRPlaneGeometry.description:
All numerical fields in metres or square metres in one orthonormal plane.
Xi/zeta axes are normal to relative velocity. Rotate displacement and
covariance together when changing basis; covariance is finite symmetric
positive semidefinite. Probability algorithms requiring an inverse reject
singular covariance unless their documented method supports it.

CQRProbabilityResult.description:
Report the actual algorithm and uncertainty origin. With
MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY_ONLY, MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY is present and PROBABILITY is
inapplicable: consumers must ignore its default zero. Never report a heuristic
maximum as probability computed from supplied covariance. Otherwise
PROBABILITY is unitless in [0,1]; supplied/synthesized covariance is explicit.

HAS_MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY.description: True when MAXIMUM_PROBABILITY carries a value; false means absent.

MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED.description: Explicitly squared distance d^T C^-1 d, dimensionless.

HAS_MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED.description: True when MAHALANOBIS_SQUARED carries a value; false means absent.

CQRNativeDocument.description:
Typed replacement of a bare raw-text port. Content is UTF-8 with no BOM;
XML declaration, if present, must agree. Content must be nonempty CDM KVN
or CDM XML matching SERIALIZATION; reject UNSPECIFIED and other documents.
Not an arbitrary JSON container.

CQRCatalogRequest.description:
Order arrays index the supplied catalog stream in exact reception order.
Ranges are half-open; absent endpoints select the full respective range.

HAS_START_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when START_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_END_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when END_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_START_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when SECONDARY_START_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_END_ORDER_INDEX.description: True when SECONDARY_END_ORDER_INDEX carries a value; false means absent.

CQREvent.description: Explicit summary when legacy source lacks sufficient data for a full CDM.

HAS_DILUTION_THRESHOLD_M.description: True when DILUTION_THRESHOLD_M carries a value; false means absent.

RELATIVE_POSITION_RTN.description: Primary-object RTN components in m and m/s; omitted when unavailable.

PRIMARY_SIGMA_RTN_M.description: One-sigma RTN values in metres, not covariance matrices.

HAS_PRIMARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH.description: True when PRIMARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SECONDARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH.description: True when SECONDARY_DAYS_SINCE_EPOCH carries a value; false means absent.

CONJUNCTION_MESSAGE.description: Full standards-backed result when physically available.

HAS_MAHALANOBIS_3D_SQUARED.description: True when MAHALANOBIS_3D_SQUARED carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_COMBINED_RADIUS_M.description: True when COMBINED_RADIUS_M carries a value; false means absent.

CQRCatalogResult.description:
Stable order by TCA then primary/secondary identity; ties retain original
input-pair order. EVENT_OFFSET indexes this order across bounded chunks.
PIV output cap, YIELDED and BACKLOG_REMAINING carry stream backpressure.

CQRIndexRequest.description:
Resident index construction reuses canonical sources, samples and PPE.
SAMPLED_STATES consumes sampled OEM records in SOURCES[].EPHEMERIS;
POLYNOMIAL_SEGMENTS consumes SEGMENTS/PPE. Handles are validated against
INSTANCE identity/generation; they are never persisted process addresses.

CQR.description:
Conjunction Query and Result — pair/catalog screening, encounter-plane
probability, typed native documents and resident screening-index control.
Exactly one arm per PIV payload, selected by the declared METHOD_ID.
